name: VitaObservationCodes
title: VITA Observation Codes (local)
publisher: VITA Project Team, CS6440 (Georgia Tech OMS)
description: Local observation codes for measurements taken from the Kaggle Heart Failure Prediction Dataset that have no suitable LOINC or SNOMED CT concept. Intended for the educational VITA prototype only.

concept.display: ST segment slope at peak exercise
concept.definition: The direction of the ST segment at peak exercise, recorded as upsloping, flat, or downsloping. Used because LOINC only models per-lead quantitative ST slope and SNOMED CT has no concept for the categorical direction at peak exercise.
